shortDescription: A framework for magical "entad" items: randomly rolled, rarity-scaled traits on weapons, apparel and furniture that reveal themselves through use, can be bound to a pawn's bloodline, and give durability, moods, abilities, damage effects and building bonuses.
body:
## Binding (EntadBinding.cs)
- An entad can be bound to one or more pawns (`CompEntad.Bind`, `EntadApi.Bind/Unbind/GetBoundPawns/TraitsActiveFor`, dev actions "Bind Entad to pawn" / "Unbind Entad"). Unbound = traits work for everyone.
- Bound items work as ordinary items for anyone; traits only work and reveal for bound pawns and their descendants (Parent relations, BFS depth 16, cached per pawn per item).
- Gated per user: wearer stats, held-item stats, damage and weapon effects, abilities, equipped hediffs, equipped/furniture moods, triggers, meals, reveals, furniture abilities, reloading, persona bonding. Always on: durability, market value, building properties, unheld items, turret guns.
- `bindOnFirstUse`: first player-faction pawn to equip or use it for themselves (never during generation, never a corpse).
- WorldPawnGC keeps bound pawns and their descendants. Discarded pawns filtered on save.
- UI: inspect "Bound to" (full names), info card row (red when holder is outside the bloodline; damage rows hidden for them), traits tooltip note, alert "Entad bound to another bloodline" for colonists and slaves incl. caravans.

## Vanilla unique and persona weapons
- Decision: no conversion to entads (stages 3–4 dropped). Instead random entad traits skip them.
- `EntadUtility.IsUniqueWeapon(def)`: weapon def with a CompUniqueWeapon or CompBladelinkWeapon (subclasses count), cached, no DLC needed.
- Setting "Unique and persona weapons get entad traits" (`UniqueWeaponChance`, 0–100% in 5% steps, default 0%) on the General tab. Rolled in both public `ApplyRandomTraits` overloads and per candidate def in `GenerateEntadItem`. Traits added by name are not affected; the dev "add random traits" action skips the chance.

## Persona weapons (EntadPersona.cs)
- Separate from binding: one pawn, ends at death or when the weapon is destroyed, raiders bond too (as vanilla). A bloodline-bound persona only bonds with, and only locks out, pawns its traits work for.
- `persona` trait (Entad_Persona, Rare, scales): rolls at random like any Rare weapon trait. Bonds on equip (or at once if added to a wielded weapon) when the pawn's vanilla `equipment.bondedWeapon` slot is free; sets that slot, so vanilla's one-bond rule, "(existing bond)" menu/dialog and {WEAPON} thought texts work. Combat bonus at Rare: melee and ranged damage ×1.08, melee cooldown and ranged cooldown ×0.8 (persona vs plain monosword). Never on vanilla bladelink defs.
- Patches: EquipmentUtility.CanEquip (bonded to someone else), AlreadyBondedToWeapon, GetPersonaWeaponConfirmationText (EF_ keys), IsBondedTo; Pawn_EquipmentTracker.Notify_EquipmentAdded (jealousy), Notify_PawnDied (unbond); ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitBonded / ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitKillNeed.CurrentStateInternal (recognise entad traits). All early-out without persona defs.
- Bond effects (need a persona trait on the item; weapon only): `bondedHediffs` (brain, while bonded), `bondedThought` (vanilla bonded worker), `otherWeaponThought` (Thought_WeaponTrait memory when wielding another primary), `killThirstThought` + `killThirstDays` (kills tracked via Notify_KilledPawn while bonded).
- `neverBond` (Freewielder): keeps the persona's stat bonus, never bonds; can't coexist with bond effects.
- `neverRandom`: general option for other mods' traits (no shipped def uses it).
- Reveal kind `Bond`: every bond-related trait fully reveals when the bond forms.
- Inspect: vanilla Core "Bonded to: X" / "Not yet bonded". Card lines per bond effect.
- Load: the pawn's slot wins on disagreement; a bond without a persona trait is dropped.
- Traits: Persona, Freewielder, Kind Whispers (+6), Mad Muttering (-3), Gluttonous (+50% hunger), Jealous (-15 for a day), Kill Thirst (-4 after 20 days). No DLC needed.

## Triggers (EntadTriggers.cs)
- `triggers` list on a trait: "when X happens, do Y". Events for worn/wielded gear: Kill, WakeUp, BillDone, JobDone (with `jobs`), TakeDamage, Downed, Eat. Furniture: Use, filtered by `use` flags Sleep / Eat / Work / Recreation / Other. A trait can't mix the two; `UseKindsOf` keeps a Use trigger off furniture that can never report its kind.
- Effects: `thought`, `hediff` (+ `hediffHours`), `heal` (worst non-permanent injuries first), `rest` / `food` / `joy`. Amounts rolled per item and scale with rarity (needs capped at 100%); `chance` and `cooldownHours` don't.
- Hooks: RecordsUtility.Notify_PawnKilled, Pawn.PostApplyDamage, Pawn_HealthTracker.MakeDowned prefix (anaesthetic skipped), Bill_Production.Notify_IterationCompleted, CleanupCurrentJob prefix (WakeUp = LayDown 1h+ with real sleep via Need_Rest.lastRestTick, not downed). Per-event "any trait uses this" flags.
- Effects run next tick from the EntadTriggerQueue GameComponent (not saved). Reveal kind `Trigger`.
- `killThought` is shorthand for a Kill trigger (weapon-only); old saves with the kill memory revealed as Mood keep it revealed.
- Traits: Last Stand, Mending Rest.

## Weapon effects (EntadWeaponTraits.cs)
- `weaponProperties`: BurstShotCount, BurstShotSpeed, StoppingPower. Info card burst/fire rate/stopping power rows rewritten from the primary verb.
- `ignoreAccuracyMaluses`, `equippedHediffs`, `partialStats`.
- Traits: Rapid Volley, Quickfire, Impact Rounds, Stormsight, Battle Joy, Clarity.

## Reloadable abilities (EntadReload.cs)
- `abilityAmmo`, `abilityAmmoPerCharge` (floored at 1), `abilityReloadTicks`; weapons and apparel. Charges on the Ability while equipped, on the trait otherwise. Reload job, float menu, JobGiver_Reload postfix. Example: Stun Charge.

## Durability
- MaxHitPoints × `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]`. Never hidden.

## Furniture mood and abilities
- CleanupCurrentJob prefix; interrupted sleep credits the bed; corpses skipped. `Thought_EntadFurniture` keyed by thingIDNumber.

## Localization / Settings / Save compatibility
- All player text keyed `EF_` (plus vanilla Core bladelink keys). Settings tabs General / Rarity and durability / Traits.
- Removed traits map through `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`; mismatched value lists re-roll alone.

## Open items
- Removing Persona leaves its bond traits on the item doing nothing.
- A pawn already bonded elsewhere while holding a persona entad doesn't bond it later until re-equipped (same as vanilla).
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors; lineage cache not invalidated mid-game; kill triggers fire on hunting/slaughter; same-length retunes keep old rolls.
- Palette pin paths are `Actions\T: <name>` (category isn't a path segment).
